Name: (FF) Animated Heart Furniture - Celeste Crystal Hearts
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

Ever wanted to see hearts floating around on your farm and around town? Well now you can! Adds 45 colour variants of the Crystal Heart's from Celeste as animated furniture into the game. These can be placed indoors and outdoors anywhere on the map, not just on your farm.

There's two 'sizes' for the hearts available as furniture in the furniture catalogue: Small (20x20 pixels) & Large (40x40 pixels).

Let me know if there's any bugs, or if you'd like me to add other heart colours!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Furniture Framework content mod, so it goes in your Smapi mods folder in order to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod 
[*]Drag and drop into your mods folder
[*]You're all done!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/87388223]Leroymilo[/url] for creating the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]﻿ mod making this mod possible, and for helping me fix some issues I had creating the mod! :)

Credit to the Maddy Makes Games team for creating Celeste

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
